title: OpenAI Partners with Amazon Web Services (AWS): Major Move in Managed Agents, Launches $500 Pro Tier Package
excerpt: The AI industry is entering a new round of infrastructure and ecosystem deepening. OpenAI has recently officially announced a strategic partnership with Amazon
content_html:
The AI industry is entering a new round of infrastructure and ecosystem deepening. OpenAI has recently officially announced a strategic partnership with Amazon Web Services (AWS), leveraging AWS's powerful infrastructure to run hosted AI agents, further expanding its presence in cloud computing and enterprise services.

In terms of enterprise collaboration ecosystem implementation, OpenAI announced the full deployment of ChatGPT into mainstream office collaboration tools Slack and Microsoft Teams. This integration breaks down existing barriers, allowing users to directly access the features without purchasing individual licenses. Data shows that currently, up to 35 million people use ChatGPT Work and Codex every week for daily system building and development tasks, and the ecosystem stickiness continues to increase.

For the extreme computing power demands of high-end professional developers, OpenAI also launched a new Pro 500-dollar package. The core highlight of this package is the inclusion of ultra-fast processing capabilities from ChatGPT and Codex, aimed at providing powerful computing support for frequent and high-throughput professional engineering tasks.

In terms of security and privacy protection, OpenAI plans to officially launch a private inference preview version this autumn. This technology combines confidential computing with strict and verifiable control mechanisms, offering enterprise users a more secure solution when handling sensitive data and high privacy compliance requirements.
